source_event.reason: Structured exact-head identity fields were current while cumulative human-readable evidence narratives still labeled ancestor SHAs as current or active exact-head evidence.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A cumulative evidence packet can keep machine-readable exact-head fields correct while a human-readable observed narrative still describes an ancestor identity as the current candidate.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Update structured exact-head fields during handoff refresh while copying forward observed text that still calls an earlier immutable identity current.

reusable_control.rule: Exact-head semantic validators reject active observed narratives that present an ancestor identity as current.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Rewrite current identity narratives from the same authoritative material identity used by structured fields.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Scan active narratives for immutable identities and fail non-current identities described with current semantics.

transfer_cases.scenario: Current structured identity with stale ancestor-as-current prose.
Current revalidated identity with stale ancestor-as-current literal prose.

skill_changes.change: Active cumulative narratives use the same current material identity as structured exact-head fields.
Inherited-control and audit-escape validators reject non-current immutable identities presented as current.
